idea-plugin.name: Slow Build Hotspots
idea-plugin.description:
Slow Build Hotspots — Find and Fix Gradle Build Bottlenecks

Analyzes your Gradle build profiles to pinpoint slow tasks, cache misses, and non-incremental operations — with actionable optimization recommendations that deliver measurable build time improvements.

Build Analysis

  • Profile Parsing — Automatically parse Gradle --profile HTML reports
  • Hotspot Detection — Ranked list of slowest tasks with severity levels (Critical, Slow, Notable)
  • Cache Miss Analysis — Detect tasks that should be cached but are not
  • Non-Incremental Detection — Find tasks that rebuild unnecessarily

Visualization

  • Performance Dashboard — Visual breakdown of build time by task, phase, and module
  • Inline Hints — Hotspot annotations directly in build.gradle(.kts) files
  • Build Health Report — Top 10 slowest tasks, cache hit rate, config vs execution split
  • Trend Graphs — 30-day build time trends with regression detection

Optimization

  • Optimization Suggestions — Specific recommendations per task with before/after projections
  • Unlimited History — Track all builds, not just the last 5
  • Data Export — Export results as CSV or JSON

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA or compatible JetBrains IDE (2024.1+)
  • Gradle project with --profile support

Support

  • Issues: GitHub
  • Email: support@jakubjirak.com
